children: Samsung Peptide is launching a takeover offer for Swiss contract drugmaker PolyPeptide Group
said in an offer prospectus on Monday.
It will offer 44.31 Swiss francs ($54.78) per registered PolyPeptide share, with the offer period set to run from September 15 to October 12.
